node.statement: Once nodes 1.5.1 and 1.4 are validated, denote their bijections by F:S_{P,Q}->direct-sum_j S_{P_j,Q} and G_j:S_{P_j,Q}->direct-sum_k S_{P_j,Q_k}. For the max norms on the finite sums, G=direct-sum_j G_j is bounded with ||G||=max_j||G_j|| and has bounded inverse direct-sum_j G_j^{-1}, whose norm is max_j||G_j^{-1}||. The coordinate-reassociation map R from direct-sum_j(direct-sum_k S_{P_j,Q_k}) to direct-sum_{j,k}S_{P_j,Q_k} is a complex-linear isometric bijection. Therefore H=R composed G composed F is a bounded complex-linear bijection and H^{-1}=F^{-1} composed (direct-sum_j G_j^{-1}) composed R^{-1}. Substituting P=v(I_B), Q=w(I_C), P_j=v(Pi_j), Q_k=w(Sigma_k) gives exactly the required map.
